title: Critical biotransformation half-lives of chemicals in air-breathing wildlife to assess food-chain bioaccumulation and biomagnification
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00220F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Roman Ashauer
This study reveals species-specific variations, across chemical partition space, in the required critical biotransformation half-life to avoid biomagnification and presents a weight-of-evidence approach with a focus on biotransformation.
